reportTitle: Q-Trend ZigZag Big Swings v8 — 30-day Binance Spot price research with synthetic 75x cross margin

rules.indicator: The attached Q-Trend ZigZag Big Swings v8 Pine v5 file, unchanged; exact source hash is listed in inputHashes.
rules.inputs: Pine defaults unchanged: close, trend period 300, ATR 20, multiplier 2.2, Type A, no EMA smoothing, Big swings (confirmed), normal and strong Buy/Sell accepted, 10% swing, 20-bar signal tolerance, 7% minimum run.
rules.signalTiming: The label timestamp and tick-formatted close price are recorded separately from the later confirmed-alert candle and executable entry. A trade enters at the first Binance Spot 1m open at alert confirmation; it is never backdated to the label.
rules.historyBoundary: Indicator state is history-start-sensitive. The study uses 14472 complete 30m warmup candles from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z because that frozen history reproduces the visible labels in the supplied LINK and NEAR screenshots.
rules.targetDefinition: Target gross PnL is 200% of the initial allocated margin, before fees; it never changes after entry.
rules.accountModel: Synthetic portfolio cross margin: all wallet equity and unrealized PnL support every open position; simultaneous positions share one maintenance test, and a breach closes every open position at observed Spot prices.
rules.maintenanceAssumption: Because Binance Spot does not offer 75x cross margin, the study uses an explicitly synthetic fixed maintenance rate of 0.5% of each open position's marked notional. This is a research assumption, not a Binance Spot or Futures rule.
rules.feeAssumption: Baseline Binance Spot fee assumption is 0.1% of notional per side for entry, target and forced exits; no user-specific VIP/BNB discount is assumed.
rules.noBorrowCost: No borrowing interest is modeled; these are synthetic leveraged positions, not actual Binance margin-account loans.
rules.exits: Only target completion or account-level cross liquidation closes positions. Opposite signals, time, stop, trailing, and manual exits are not used.
rules.fillAssumptions: Entry at next 1m Spot candle open. Targets are limit-style fills at the target price, verified from historical Spot aggregate trades using correctly directed aggressor volume at or through the target. Queue position and slippage cannot be reconstructed; no extra spread is invented.
rules.ambiguityHandling: 1m OHLC is used to screen possible target/liquidation minutes; candidate minutes are resolved in timestamp order using official Binance Spot aggregate trades for all open symbols. A liquidation breach is evaluated before a target fill at the same millisecond. Missing detail aborts the run rather than assuming a favorable fill.
rules.quantityModel: Continuous synthetic quantity = allocated margin × 75 / entry price. Spot LOT_SIZE and minimum-notional constraints are not imposed because the requested account is not an actual Spot order or margin account.

data.source: Official Binance Spot public API: 30m klines for confirmed signal calculation and 1m klines for entries, range screening, and cutoff marks; official Binance Spot aggregate-trade archives/API for candidate-minute event order and target volume.
data.pineInterpreter: Local PineTS 0.13.1 on the intact Pine v5 source, including its actual backdated label drawings; visible LINK/NEAR screenshot labels are checked by exact side and displayed price. This is not independent certification against a TradingView alert export.
